title: China Announces Joint Naval-Air Drills Near Scarborough Shoal; Philippines Disputes Claim as 'Not Credible'
detail: China's PLA Southern Theater Command announced it conducted joint naval and air combat-readiness drills near Scarborough Shoal on August 1, 2026, involving bombers, guided-missile frigates, helicopters, and coast guard vessels, days after the Philippines presented its extended continental shelf claim off Palawan to the UN. The PLA called it "a necessary action taken in light of the current situation in the South China Sea and in response to the acts of certain countries within the region that have undermined regional peace and stability." On August 3, the Philippines' National Maritime Council disputed China's account, saying monitoring detected a Chinese vessel presence but that Philippine security agencies "detected no such activities" of an actual live military drill in the area, calling China's claim "not credible."

media.caption: PLA and coastguards stage South China Sea drills days after Philippine territorial bid

confidenceReason: China's PLA claimed live joint drills near Scarborough Shoal on Aug 1; the Philippines' National Maritime Council disputed the claim on Aug 3 as 'not credible,' saying only vessel presence — not drills — was detected.

title: China Releases Fishing and Mining Ban Rules for Scarborough Shoal 'Nature Reserve'
detail: China released a formal set of management rules on August 1, 2026 for the "national nature reserve" it declared around Scarborough Shoal in 2025, banning unauthorized fishing, mining, and harvesting of corals and giant clams, and mandating regular patrols to enforce the restrictions. The rules effectively formalize China's exclusion of Filipino fishers from waters the Philippines considers part of its exclusive economic zone. The move drew criticism a week later from the United States, which called it a "dubious" environmental and legal pretext to advance China's maritime claims.

media.caption: China releases fishing and mining ban rules for its Scarborough Shoal 'nature reserve'
